gap: Stale When picker from the phone card's More menu writes an old date (and an old weekday) over another tab's edit. SEED (clock Tue 2026-03-10 09:00 America/New_York, phone viewport 390x844 with touch): things-todos=[{id:'t1',title:'Take out bins',when:'2026-03-10',project:'p_house',repeat:{mode:'schedule',every:1,unit:'week'}}]. Two tabs in one context, both on #/project/p_house. STEPS: (1) Tab A: tap the row (opens its card), tap More in the card bar (#detail-bar [data-bar=more]); leave the menu open. (2) Tab B: tap the row, tap the card's When chip, pick Fri 13 Mar. Storage now has when 2026-03-13. (3) Tab A (its storage event has arrived): tap More > When..., then tap Add Reminder, then Done. EXPECTED (CONTRACT, Repeating to-dos, Several tabs): 'An open When picker follows its to-do the same way: another tab's date, reminder and rule show in it, each change made in it applies only what was changed there to the to-do as stored now', and a tab 'never writes its stale copy over the other tab's work'. So the picker shows Fri 13 Mar, and adding a reminder leaves when=2026-03-13. ACTUAL (2/2 clean runs): tab A's picker marks Today as current, its Repeats note says 'Next: Tue, Mar 17' and Weekly shows Tuesday on. After Add Reminder the storage is when='2026-03-10', reminder '10:00': tab B's Friday is silently reverted, and the weekly series moves back to Tuesdays. VARIANT (2/2): at step 3 tap Thu in the Repeats section instead. Storage gets weekdays [2,4] (Tue from the stale date, plus Thu) instead of [4,5]. Completing it on Fri 13 Mar then spawns the next one on Tue 17 Mar. The same stale reminder is written when a date is picked, which drops a reminder set in tab B. No page errors. CAUSE: detail.js renderPhoneBar captures t=getTodo(id) when More is tapped, and 'When...' calls when.open({value:t.when, reminder:t.reminder}). when.js follow() only runs on the next emit, and commitReminder's refresh() finds nothing new (the event already loaded), so onPick writes the stale value. Desktop paths read the to-do fresh at click and are fine. ALSO TRIED, no break: 7 seeded random UI walks (1 and 2 tabs, 60 to 90 steps: row toggles, Cmd+K, toolbar Complete All with and without a selection, Clear completed, delete, card title and notes with Escape/Enter/click/card checkbox, picker rule edits, move, heading delete, reload, next day) checking one open repeating per series, no duplicate occurrence numbers, no unexplained removals and no page errors; picker keyboard and click fuzz with another tab rewriting the rule (desktop and phone); untick after reload and after Delete Heading; phone More > Complete / Mark as Open with a typed title. Design issues noted, not claimed: Stop Repeating or rule edits in a completed occurrence's picker do not reach the live next occurrence; Complete All reads checked (invisibly) when the only open to-do is a next occurrence, so a click reopens yesterday's occurrence and takes today's back (this is store.allCompleted by contract).
why: Phone More > When... opens the picker on a stale date and writes it back over another tab's edit, reverting the date and the weekly phase (contract: an open When picker shows another tab's date and applies only what was changed there)
